name: orka
description: Orka - AI core, chat UI, VS Code extension, CLI and desktop app
author: Enophia Software

scripts.build: npm run build -w @orka/core && npm run build -w orka-vscode && npm run build -w orka-agent && npm run build -w orka-desktop
scripts.test: npm test -w @orka/core && npm test -w @orka/app && npm test -w orka-agent && npm test -w orka-desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @orka/core && npm run typecheck -w @orka/app && npm run typecheck -w orka-vscode && npm run typecheck -w orka-agent && npm run typecheck -w orka-desktop
